name: get_pouches
description: List the user's pouches with balance, spent today, limits and whether frozen.

name: create_order
description: Build a draft cart from the user's request. Does not pay. Returns the cart and a `say` readback.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their words.

pouchId.description: Optional pouch to use; omit to let Solpouch choose.

name: confirm_order
description: Pay for a draft cart. Only call after the user said yes to the exact cart that was read back.

name: freeze_all
description: Freeze every pouch immediately. No more payments until the owner unfreezes in the app.
